    Vince Giordano and the Nighthawks

    5:30 PM · Birdland Theater, Hell's Kitchen · $24.91 · ↻ Also on other days Algo especial

    In his Birdland Theater residency, GRAMMY® Award winner, New York native, and multi-instrumentalist Vince Giordano leads The Nighthawks -- an 11-piece band who have set the standard for recreating authentic jazz sounds of the 1920s and beyond. In addition to club and concert appearances around the world, the band has provided period soundtracks for film and television productions including The Cotton Club, The Aviator, Finding Forrester, Revolutionary Road, Cafe Society, HBOs Boardwalk Empire, The Marvelous Mrs. Maisel, the upcoming Martin Scorsese film Killers of The Flower Moon, and many more.

    Salisha Thomas: The Possibility Project

    7:00 PM · Birdland Jazz Club, Hell's Kitchen · $30.06 Algo especial

    NEW YORK, NY Broadway star and acclaimed vocalist Salisha Thomas will bring The Possibility Project to Birdland Jazz Club on Monday, November 2 at 7:00 PM. An intimate evening of music, storytelling, and inspiration, The Possibility Project traces Thomass journey from Disney to Broadway and beyond through the songs, artists, and experiences that have helped shape her life and career.Featuring beloved music associated with Carole King, Lena Horne, and other legendary artists, the evening combines personal stories with songs that celebrate ambition, resilience, reinvention, and the unexpected turns that can lead to extraordinary places. At the heart of The Possibility Project is a simple idea: the life youre dreaming about may be closer than you think. Salisha Thomas is a Broadway actress, singer, producer, author, and host. She made her Broadway debut in Beautiful: The Carole King Musical before starring in Once Upon a One More Time. She has performed alongside Hugh Jackman at Radio City Music Hall, the Hollywood Bowl, and arenas across North America. Thomas is also the author of Why Be a 9 When You Can Be a 10 and the creator and host of The Salisha Show podcast, where she brings her trademark curiosity and enthusiasm to conversations about creativity, career, and living life to its fullest potential.

    8:00 PM · Sony Hall, Midtown-Times Square

    Get ready for an extraordinary night where the thunder of rock and roll meets the heart of Broadway! Celebrating 33 landmark years, Rockers On Broadway 33 sets the stage to a wide-open celebration of music across every genre.     The Cabaret Burlesque presents: Code Red

    8:00 PM · Berlin, East Village · $42.71 · ↻ Every Monday Para salir

    VIP experience includes: meet and greet and champagne TCB presents: CODE RED Code Red: Industry Night Weekly on Monday Doors 7:30pm Guest Opening Act 8pm Main Show featuring The Cabaret Burlesque 8:30 - 10:30pm Music and Bar until 1am Contact @thecabaretburlesque on instagram to APPLY to perform as an Opening Act An Industry Night where your wildest fantasies just might come true. Welcome to CODE RED---an electrifying world where Parisian cabaret meets Amsterdam's edge, Moscow's mystique, and the unapologetic glamour of Studio 54. Fashion is as much a part of the performance as the artists themselves, with striking couture, bold silhouettes, and runway-worthy style setting the scene for an unforgettable night. Expect dazzling performances, intoxicating music, provocative artistry, and immersive moments that blur the line between audience and spectacle. Inspired by the golden age of nightlife, where icons, artists, and dreamers came to see and be seen, CODE RED celebrates fearless self-expression, decadent entertainment, and the thrill of the unexpected. Dress boldly. Stay curious. Bring your calling card. Welcome to the show where fantasy, fashion, and nightlife collide.
